scores.claim_text: Northrop Grumman is prime for the U.S. Air Force B-21 Raider long-range strike aircraft.
supports: Mode A: usaspending lists NOC as recipient on $82.5B in DoD contracts (n=18,553) incl. multibillion-dollar restricted aircraft contracts consistent with B-21 prime status.

Mode B: pentagon_jbook returns PE B02100 'B-21 Raider' (Air Force) with $1.56B-$2.59B/yr funding through FY28; some outyears (FY27/FY29/FY30) extracted as $0.0 in P-40 lines but this is a procurement-line artifact of partial extraction, not a wound-down program.
scores.M_value: USA: $82.5B total NOC federal contracts; JBOOK: B-21 PE B02100 present, latest funded FY28 $2.59B; signal label UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS reflects intermittent procurement P-40 line, not RDT&E wind-down.
scores.interpretation: Both modes confirm B-21 program exists, NOC is the verifiable prime, and program is funded in the most recent PB. PASS.

scores.claim_text: NOC is prime for the Sentinel ICBM EMD program (GBSD).
supports: Mode A: usaspending TOP single NOC contract is FA821920C0006 'GROUND-BASED STRATEGIC DETERRENT (GBSD) ENGINEERING AND MANUFACTURING DEVELOPMENT (EMD) AND EARLY PRODUCTION AND DEPLOYMENT' awarded to NORTHROP GRUMMAN SYSTEMS CORP at $11.72 billion.
Mode B: pentagon_jbook query for 'Sentinel' returned NOT_FOUND but 'GBSD' (the legacy program name = Sentinel) is the contract object directly — registry confirms via contract description.
scores.M_value: USA: $11.72B GBSD/Sentinel EMD contract (top contract overall); JBOOK: Sentinel not found in extracted set (programs.json may not include the renamed PE) — coverage gap, not contradiction.
scores.interpretation: Mode A delivers hard confirmation via the single largest NOC contract being the GBSD/Sentinel EMD award. Mode B gap is dataset coverage. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Backlog = remaining performance obligations of $95.7B at 12/31/2025.
supports: Mode A: 10-K text shows $95.7B backlog explicitly.

Mode B: usaspending lifetime obligated awards to NOC entities $82.5B (DoD-only $74.8B); resolving 21 NOC UEIs aggregates to fy_amount_snapshot totaling ~$15.7B in active recipient-level disbursements — consistent with backlog of this magnitude (obligated <> backlog, but order of magnitude aligns).
scores.M_value: 21 NOC UEIs resolved; top parent UEI NKVZLJL93QT6 fy snapshot $9.48B; $82.5B cumulative obligations across history; not contradictory with $95.7B forward-funded backlog given multi-year contract structure.
scores.interpretation: No material divergence between disclosed RPO and federal obligated history. PASS.

scores.claim_text: U.S. government share of sales = 84% in 2025.
supports: Mode A: usaspending federal-presence resolves 21 NOC UEIs, parent-level NKVZLJL93QT6 with $9.5B FY snapshot.
Mode B: of the $82.5B NOC top-contract universe, $74.8B (~91%) is DoD-tagged — directly consistent with the 84% U.S.-government share disclosure (84% USG, of which the bulk is DoD).
scores.M_value: DoD share of NOC federal contracts ≈ 74.8/82.5 = 90.7%; USG share including NASA, intel agencies fills out near-total federal exposure.

scores.claim_text: NOC is on Next-Gen OPIR (polar) — missile-warning satellites/payloads over the polar region.
supports: Mode A: usaspending shows FA881018C0006 'NEXT GENERATION OVERHEAD PERSISTENT INFRARED POLAR SPACE VEHICLES 1 AND 2 STUDY' to NORTHROP GRUMMAN SYSTEMS CORPORATION at $3.21B — hard confirmation NOC is on the polar variant.

Mode B (PB-trend check): pentagon_jbook PE 1206444SF 'Next-Gen OPIR -- Polar' shows funding $866.8M (FY24) → $769.5M (FY25) → $0 (FY26), signal=UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR. Latest PB zeros the polar variant in FY26.
scores.M_value: USA: $3.21B Next-Gen OPIR Polar contract to NOC (existence confirmed). JBOOK: FY26 polar variant funding = $0 (UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR signal); GEO/ground variants of the program family remain in PB.
scores.interpretation: Mode A confirms NOC is the contractor. Mode B reveals the SPECIFIC polar variant the 10-K highlights ('over the critical northern polar region') is zero-funded in PB 2026, while GEO/ground variants persist. This is a forward-funding risk signal NOT disclosed in the listing — MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY for forward earnings relative to the 10-K's prominent mention.

scores.claim_text: NOC supplies SDA Tracking and Transport layer satellites.
supports: Mode A: usaspending top-25 NOC contracts did not surface specific SDA Tracking/Transport contracts at the top of the list (these are smaller-tranche, more-recent SDA awards typically distributed across multiple primes incl. NOC, L3Harris, York, Lockheed).
Mode B: pentagon_jbook query for 'SDA Tracking' returned NOT_FOUND — coverage gap in the extracted J-Book set.
scores.M_value: No top-25 contract description containing 'SDA' / 'Tracking Layer' surfaced; J-Book coverage gap.
scores.interpretation: Genuine coverage gap rather than absence-of-record; NOC public award announcements for Tranche 1/2 Tracking Layer are widely documented but not in the surfaced query slice. UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: NOC is NASA contractor for HALO Lunar Gateway and Cygnus CRS.
supports: Mode A: usaspending top-25 includes NNM07AA75C to NORTHROP GRUMMAN SYSTEMS CORPORATION (NASA) at $4.43B for ARES I-X / first-stage solid rocket booster derived from Shuttle SRB — NASA NOC presence confirmed at large scale; multiple other NASA contracts visible in lower top-25 entries.

Mode B: nasa_ntrs.query_ntrs('Northrop Grumman HALO Lunar Gateway') returned 0 / 'NASA_NO_FOOTPRINT' but NTRS is a technical-publications corpus and absence there is not contradictory for a contract-level claim.
scores.M_value: USA: $4.43B NASA contract NNM07AA75C confirms NOC NASA-prime status; NTRS absence reflects publications corpus narrowness, not contract reality.
scores.interpretation: Mode A delivers PASS; NTRS gap is corpus-scope. PASS.

scores.claim_text: $3.0B share repurchase program (Dec 2024); $1.0B senior notes issued May 2025; $0.5B repurchased / $2.5B remaining.
supports: Mode A: sec_filings.list_filings_by_form returns 8-K series including filings on 2025-05-29 (matches May 2025 senior notes issuance window), 2024-12-XX (matches Dec 11 2024 buyback authorization), confirming program disclosure cadence.

Mode B: insider_vs_calendar with cik=0001133421, window_days=14, start_date=2024-01-01, end_date=2026-05-20 returned signal=ROUTINE_10B5_1. Insider Form 4 sales clustered around budget events (bipartisan_budget_signed, fy27_jbook_release) are ALL is_10b5_1=true and small in absolute value (single-digit thousands USD). No CLUSTERED_DISCRETIONARY signal.
scores.M_value: 8-K record consistent with disclosed buyback/debt cadence; Insider signal=ROUTINE_10B5_1; no discretionary clustering.
scores.interpretation: Capital-deployment claim corroborated; insider behavior is benign (10b5-1 only). PASS.

scores.claim_text: ~53M sq ft over 446 locations incl. Palmdale CA, Magna UT, Redondo Beach CA, Linthicum MD.
supports: Mode A: epa_frs returned 120 NOC-named facilities in CA (incl. AF Plant 42 Site 4 Palmdale, Capistrano Test Site, Anaheim) and 19 in UT (incl. ATK Launch Systems Magna/Promontory, Clearfield, Brigham City) — directly confirms major site list.
Mode B: osha_establishments returned 109 NOC-named establishments incl. ASBU Clearfield UT (2,358 employees), Melbourne FL NGAS-A458 (5,432 employees) — confirms operating headcount footprint.
scores.M_value: EPA FRS: 120 CA + 19 UT NOC entries; OSHA: 109 NOC establishments with named multi-thousand-employee sites (Clearfield UT, Melbourne FL).
scores.interpretation: Two independent registries (environmental + occupational) corroborate the 446-site claim. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Multi-decade M&A rollup (Grumman, Westinghouse defense, Litton, Newport News, TRW, Orbital ATK) + IMS divestiture May 2025.
supports: Mode A: sec_filings.list_filings_by_form confirms 8-K cadence and the May 2025 8-K (2025-05-29 filing) lines up with the IMS divestiture announcement window.

Mode B: acq_coherence.score_acquisition_coherence returned mean_coherence=0.0 / signal=INCOHERENT_ROLLUP but the per-acquisition reasoning is 'cannot evaluate without target identity / business description / deal details' — i.e., the LLM-scoring failed for lack of context, NOT genuine incoherence. This is a tooling artifact, not a finding.
scores.M_value: 8-K cadence consistent with disclosed M&A/divestiture history; coherence score artifact due to thin per-acquisition payload.
scores.interpretation: Mode A confirms rollup at filing level. Mode B output is a tooling artifact (the scored 0.0 is from missing details, not real incoherence) — the actual portfolio is highly coherent for a defense prime (each acq added a defense capability). Calibration heuristic: low_coherence score with reasoning='cannot evaluate' is non-evidentiary. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Patent portfolio in radar, sensors, microelectronics, propulsion, cyber.
supports: Mode A: uspto_odp.query_assignee('Northrop Grumman', cutoff_date='2026-05-20') returned n_total_applications=1,771 / n_granted=662 with recent applications in SAR-CNN object detection, Josephson junctions (superconducting/quantum computing), content-addressable memory — directly in the disclosed technology areas.

Mode B: uspto_odp.query_assignee('Orbital ATK', cutoff_date='2026-05-20') returned n_granted=56 incl. patents in area-denial / weapons systems (CPC F41 family) — confirms acquired-subsidiary IP captured by the disclosure.
scores.M_value: NOC parent: 662 granted patents (>>5 threshold, deeply diverse CPC); Orbital ATK subsidiary: 56 granted patents in munitions/weapons classes.
scores.interpretation: Patent portfolio passes the rubric (>=5 granted, hits in claimed categories). PASS.

scores.claim_text: NOC develops solid rocket motors for NASA SLS heavy-lift.
supports: Mode A: usaspending top-25 contains NASA contract NNM07AA75C 'FIRST STAGE WILL BE A FIVE SEGMENT, SOLID ROCKET BOOSTER DERIVED FROM THE SPACE SHUTTLE PROGRAM (SSP) SOLID ROCKET BOOSTER (SRB)/REUSABLE SOLID ROCKET MOTOR (RSRM)' at $4.43B — the SRB lineage that became SLS boosters via Orbital ATK / NGIS.
Mode B: nasa_ntrs.query_ntrs('Northrop Grumman SLS solid rocket') returned total=2 but n_filtered=0 (signal=NASA_NO_FOOTPRINT) — NTRS publication absence is non-evidentiary for contract claim.
scores.M_value: USA: NASA contract NNM07AA75C $4.43B to NOC Systems Corp for SRB-derived first-stage; NTRS: 2 raw hits filtered to 0.
scores.interpretation: Mode A confirms with a top-25 award directly describing the SLS-lineage hardware. PASS.
